title: Procedural Role of Departmental Officer in Customs and Compliance
summary: The role of the 'departmental officer' has evolved from a simple authorizing agent for scrap disposal and certification to a central administrative node in complex customs verification and committee-based decision-making processes. Over time, the officer's responsibilities have expanded from passive certification to active nomination of inspection teams and participation in multi-agency regulatory committees.

evolution.scope: Expanded from individual authorization to committee-based oversight and team management.
evolution.procedure: Shifted from reactive approval to proactive nomination and structured reporting cycles.

timeline.change: Officer acts as an authorizing authority for the disposal of industrial scrap.
Officer gains administrative power to nominate physical inspection officers and receive inspection reports within strict timelines.
Officer is integrated as a mandatory member of a multi-agency committee for regulatory approvals.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৫। আমদানিকৃত যন্ত্রাংশ বা উপকরণ দ্বারা মোটরসাইকেল বা যন্ত্রাংশ উৎপাদনের ফলে সৃষ্ট অপচয়জনিত স্ক্র্যাপ সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগীয় কর্মকর্তার অনুমোদনক্রমে স্থানীয়ভাবে বিক্রয় করা যাইবে এবং এই ক্ষেত্রে উক্ত স্ক্র্যাপের মূল্যের উপর প্রযোজ্য হারে মূল্য সংযোজন কর কিংবা প্রযোজ্য অন্যান্য শুল্ক-কর আমদানিকারককে পরিশোধ করিতে হইবে।

Motorcycle Manufacturing: Manufacturers of motorcycles or their components are permitted to sell scrap resulting from production processes locally, provided they obtain authorization from the relevant customs officer.
Value Added Tax: The importer is required to pay the applicable rate of Value Added Tax on the value of scrap sold locally arising from the production of motorcycles or their components.
Customs Duty: In addition to other taxes, the importer must pay all applicable customs duties on the value of locally sold production scrap.
Appropriate Officer of Customs: Local sale of production scrap generated from imported parts or materials is subject to the prior approval of the relevant departmental officer.

member_objects.resolved_text: ২১. কাস্টমস স্টেশনের অনুরোধের পরিপ্রেক্ষিতে অনুরোধ প্রাপ্তির ২ (দুই) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে কাস্টমস, এক্সাইজ ও ভ্যাট বিভাগের সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগীয় কর্মকর্তা পরিশিষ্ট ৭.৪ মোতাবেক প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিজস্ব আমদানী পণ্য বা রপ্তানি পণ্য কায়িক পরীক্ষা করার জন্য এক বা একাধিক কায়িক পরীক্ষণ কর্মকর্তা মনোনয়ন প্রদান করবে।

Customs Physical Examination: The relevant departmental officer must nominate one or more physical examination officers to conduct the examination of imported or exported goods belonging to an entity.
The nomination process must be completed within two working days upon receiving a formal request from the customs station, following the procedure outlined in the relevant appendix.
Customs, Excise and VAT Department: Officers from this department are responsible for nominating officials to perform physical examinations of goods upon receiving a request from a customs station.

member_objects.resolved_text: ২২. মনোনীত কর্মকর্তা মনোনয়ন প্রাপ্তির ৩ (তিন) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে প্রতিষ্ঠানের অজ্ঞানে আমদানি পণ্য বা রপ্তানিব্য পণ্য কায়িক পরীক্ষা করে পরিশিষ্ট ৭.৫ অনুসারে কায়িক পরীক্ষণ প্রতিবেদন সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগীয় কর্মকর্তা বরাবর প্রেরণ করবে।

Customs Inspection Process: Designated officers are required to conduct a physical examination of imported or exported goods within a set number of working days upon receiving the nomination. The inspection result must be formally submitted in the specified report format to the relevant departmental officer.
Physical Examination Report: This report must be prepared following the standardized structure outlined in the relevant appendix and submitted by the assigned official to the competent departmental authority.

National Board of Revenue: Upon receiving an application under the established provisions, the National Board of Revenue is mandated to form a committee to process the matter.
Committee for Application Review: A committee is established consisting of the Second Secretary of Customs Policy, the relevant departmental officer, a representative from the Ministry of Industries, and a representative from a public university in Bangladesh to review applications.
